title: Universal homotopy coherent localization interface
statement: Let $A$ be an ordinary category, $W$ a class of its morphisms, and $K$ a simplicial set [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Use the mapping spaces, coherent functor simplicial sets, equivalence edges, full subcategories and coherent functor equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. The enlarged nerve $N(A)$ has simplices the degreewise universe lifts of strings of composable arrows. A simplicial map $q:N(A)\to K$ inverts $W$ if every edge coming from $W$ maps to an equivalence edge. Write $\operatorname{Fun}_W(N(A),T)$ for the full subcategory of $\operatorname{Fun}(N(A),T)$ on these edge-inverting functors. Say $q$ is a homotopy coherent localization if $K$ is a quasicategory, $q$ inverts $W$, and, for every quasicategory $T$ in the chosen enlarged universe, precomposition by $q$ factors through $\operatorname{Fun}_W(N(A),T)$ as a coherent functor equivalence. In particular the whole coherent functor category, including its mapping spaces and higher simplices, occurs in this universal property. The image of an ordinary object is its zero-simplex under $q$. Two objects are equivalent if an equivalence edge has them as endpoints; a compositional triangle is a two-simplex with the specified three edges. All object and morphism universes of $A$ are independent, and the simplicial-set universe contains both.
